content.text: Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau, Gen. 27:22. Stretch out thine hand over the sea, Ex. 14:26. Thy right hand … glorious in power, Ex. 15:6. tooth for tooth, hand for hand, Ex. 21:24 (Deut. 19:21). will cover thee with my hand while I pass by, Ex. 33:22. shew thy servant … thy mighty hand, Deut. 3:24. for a sign upon your hand, Deut. 11:18. nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother, Deut. 15:7. hand of the Lord was against them for evil, Judg. 2:15. Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark, 2 Sam. 6:6 (1 Chr. 13:10). fall now into the hand of the Lord, 2 Sam. 24:14 (1 Chr. 21:13). hand of the Lord was on Elijah, 1 Kgs. 18:46. hand of God hath touched me, Job 19:21. He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart, Ps. 24:4. I will wash mine hands in innocency, Ps. 26:6. I will lift up my hands in thy name, Ps. 63:4. establish thou the work of our hands upon us, Ps. 90:17. bear thee up in their hands, Ps. 91:12 (Matt. 4:6; Luke 4:11). heavens are the work of thy hands, Ps. 102:25 (Heb. 1:10). Sit thou at my right hand, Ps. 110:1 (Matt. 22:44; Mark 12:36; Luke 20:42–43; Acts 2:34–35). Thy hands have made me and fashioned me, Ps. 119:73. hands that shed innocent blood, Prov. 6:17. Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished, Prov. 11:21. slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, Prov. 19:24 (26:15). I will not hear: your hands are full of blood, Isa. 1:15. his hand is stretched out still, Isa. 9:12 (2 Ne. 19:12). child shall put his hand on the cockatrice’ den, Isa. 11:8 (2 Ne. 21:8; 30:14). day of the Lord is at hand, Isa. 13:6 (Joel 1:15; Zeph. 1:7). Lord’s hand is not shortened, Isa. 59:1. we all are the work of thy hand, Isa. 64:8. spread out my hands … unto a rebellious people, Isa. 65:2 (Rom. 10:21). as the clay is in the potter’s hand, Jer. 18:6. hand of the Lord was strong upon me, Ezek. 3:14 (3:22; 8:1; 37:1). All hands shall be feeble, Ezek. 7:17. mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see, Ezek. 13:9. they shall become one in thine hand, Ezek. 37:17. stone was cut out without hands, Dan. 2:34 (2:45; D&C 65:2). king saw the part of the hand that wrote, Dan. 5:5.

kingdom of heaven is at hand, Matt. 3:2 (4:17; 10:7; Mark 1:15; D&C 39:19). Whose fan is in his hand, Matt. 3:12 (Luke 3:17). if thy right hand offend thee, Matt. 5:30 (18:8; Mark 9:43). let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth, Matt. 6:3. man which had his hand withered, Matt. 12:10 (Mark 3:1; Luke 6:6). to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man, Matt. 15:20. Pilate … washed his hands before the multitude, Matt. 27:24. No man, having put his hand to the plough, Luke 9:62. kingdom of God is nigh at hand, Luke 21:31. Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit, Luke 23:46 (Ps. 31:5). Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself, Luke 24:39. hath given all things into his hand, John 3:35. neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand, John 10:28. they smote him with their hands, John 19:3. he shewed unto them his hands, John 20:20. see in his hands the print, John 20:25. saw … Jesus standing on the right hand of God, Acts 7:55 (7:56). Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body, 1 Cor. 12:15. salutation of me Paul with mine own hand, 1 Cor. 16:21 (Col. 4:18; 2 Thes. 3:17). an house not made with hands, 2 Cor. 5:1. Christ sitteth on the right hand of God, Col. 3:1. day of Christ is at hand, 2 Thes. 2:2. lifting up holy hands, without wrath, 1 Tim. 2:8. more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, Heb. 9:11. to fall into the hands of the living God, Heb. 10:31. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners, James 4:8. end of all things is at hand, 1 Pet. 4:7. Humble yourselves … under the mighty hand of God, 1 Pet. 5:6. he laid his right hand upon me, Rev. 1:17. had a pair of balances in his hand, Rev. 6:5. receive his mark … in his hand, Rev. 14:9.

I make it with mine own hand, 1 Ne. 1:3. after they go forth by the hand of the twelve apostles, 1 Ne. 13:26. did cause my people … to labor with their hands, 2 Ne. 5:17. with pure hearts and clean hands, 2 Ne. 25:16. that I may set my hand again, 2 Ne. 29:1. stretches forth his hands unto them, Jacob 6:4. made me an instrument in his hands, Mosiah 23:10. he touched with his hand the disciples, 3 Ne. 18:36. Know ye not that ye are in the hands of God, Morm. 5:23. ancient inhabitants who were destroyed by the hand of the Lord, Ether 1:1.

reveal … the Priesthood, by the hand of Elijah, D&C 2:1. Behold … prints of the nails in my hands, D&C 6:37. with the labor of his hands, to prepare and accomplish the things, D&C 38:40. all flesh is in mine hand, D&C 61:6. heavens and the earth are in mine hands, D&C 67:2. cleanse your hands, D&C 88:74. salutations … with uplifted hands unto the Most High, D&C 88:120. things which I required at their hands, D&C 105:3 (105:10). Enos was ordained … by the hand of Adam, D&C 107:44. offer him your hand and request him to shake hands, D&C 129:4 (129:7–8).
he put his hand upon mine eyes, Abr. 3:12.
